skill.displayName: AI Feet Generator – Create Realistic Feet Images Online – API-powered
skill.summary: AI feet generator — generate a realistic low-angle bare feet photo from a portrait

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-feet-openapi-skill 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Generate realistic low-angle bare feet photos from portrait or full-body images.
- Requires HTTPS and WeShop API key for authentication.
- Secure usage instructions included; API key must only be sent to openapi.weshop.ai.
- Supports image upload, custom scene instructions, and batch generation (1–16 images).
- Provides clear endpoint details and polling workflow for result retrieval.
